sources.locator: Garnet 2.0: Configuration (ni_flit_size and buffers_per_data_vc); Network Components (NetworkLink/CreditLink); Flow Control; Buffer Management; Lifecycle of a Network Traversal, especially OutputUnit credit reception, SwitchAllocator credit decrement/return and NetworkLink latency
sources.supports: Flits as transfer granularity; finite buffer capacity communicated by credits; link traversal with explicit delay.
sources.limits: The authored single-link order, fixture failures, byte counts and MAC timing are not gem5 implementation or measured device performance. No virtual channels, routing, checksum, physical link framing or production protocol claims.

checks.unitsAndDenominators: Actual source bytes, valid physical payload, padded slot bytes, unique accepted bytes, flit counts and credit reservations are kept separate. Every snapshot conserves credits and sends/arrivals/dequeues. All times are synthetic ticks.
checks.modelAssumptions: Fixed architecture-presets matrices, little-endian int32, one local and one transferred operand, FIFO/one-flit injection, positive return/transit delay, finite receiver service and pause. Omission happens before send; no random error rate/retry or hardware timing.
checks.claimQualifiers: Identity checks do not authenticate data. Wrong payload flows to actual MACs and is detected only by a separate original-matrix reference. Duplicate rejection frees its slot; incomplete operands never enter the consumer. No production protocol or physical device validation.
checks.dependencyAndVisualScope: Same matrix-two/three-int32-le-1 and A/B/C coordinate identities as existing selected-operation specimens. UI presents actual event prefix, counters, destination words and MACs; final reference/details explicitly distinguished from selected tick. The completeness API is shared by premature and normal requests.
